cohort: Mothers with preterm infants admitted to neonatal care units (NCUs) of two referral hospitals in Kenya (n=182)
finding: The prevalence of PTSD among mothers of preterm infants was high (78.6%), and significant predictors included cesarean section birth and housing conditions, while having a previous preterm birth was associated with a lower likelihood of PTSD.
mod_finding: Cesarean section birth was significantly associated with an increased likelihood of developing PTSD.
